prose.text: The App Connector sits on the application side of every ZPA flow. Questions about it split by what the reader is trying to learn:

steps.label: Where does it run and how many are needed?
steps.text: Outbound-only behavior, redundancy, platforms and limits: [[zpa.app-connectors.deployment]].

steps.label: Which group does it belong to and what does the group control?
steps.text: Membership, DNS option, version profile, enrollment certificate and user codes: [[zpa.app-connectors.connector-groups]].

steps.label: How does it enroll?
steps.text: Methods, certificates, re-enrollment and what blocks a new connector: [[zpa.app-connectors.enrollment]]; the key itself in [[zpa.app-connectors.provisioning-keys]], and how SDKs and tools model it in [[zpa.app-connectors.provisioning-key-tooling]].

steps.label: When and how is it updated?
steps.text: Group schedule, statuses, failures and host OS: [[zpa.app-connectors.upgrades]].

steps.label: Is it healthy?
steps.text: Status values, log fields, pause state and streaming limits: [[zpa.app-connectors.health]].

steps.label: Which connector serves a session?
steps.text: Selection inputs, stickiness and a zero connector ID: [[zpa.app-connectors.selection]].

prose.text: Provider and SDK defects that touch connectors and groups are in [[zpa.sdk-go.service-defects]], [[zpa.terraform.resource-fidelity]] and [[shared.sdk-go.zero-value-writes]].
